name: PEN SPY CAMERA
description:
HD Camera Pen – Power Meets Secrecy

Looks like a pen. Records like a pro. Nobody will ever know.

VIP PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
The ultimate tool for discreet documentation.

Ye koi aam pen nahi hai. Ye hai HD 1080P Camera Pen – ek executive look wala smart device jo audio aur video dono HD quality mein record karta hai. Meeting notes, lectures, ya personal security – is pen ko pocket mein rakho aur har important moment capture karo bina kisi ko pata chale.

90 minutes non-stop recording battery, 32GB memory support, aur crystal clear audio ke saath ye pen banaya gaya hai un logon ke liye jo evidence, proof, ya yaadein mehfooz rakhna chahte hain.

WHY THIS PEN IS DIFFERENT
True HD 1080P Video:  result mein bhi dikhta hai. Sharp, detailed footage har dafa.
Dual Function – Camera + Pen: Haan, is se likhai bhi hoti hai. 100% functional ballpoint pen.
One-Click Recording: Pocket se nikalo, button dabao, recording shuru. No lights, no sound, no suspicion.
90 Min Battery Backup: Continuous recording 1.5 ghante tak. Charge ho jata hai kisi bhi Samsung/Micro-USB charger se.
32GB Memory Support: 8–10 ghante ki HD footage store karo. Micro SD card slot built-in.
Clear Voice Capture: Built-in mic door tak ki awaaz bhi saaf record karta hai.
Plug & Play: Recording ke baad PC/Laptop mein lagao, videos direct chalao. Koi software nahi chahiye.

TECH SPECS
| Feature | Detail |
| **Video Resolution** | 1080P HD @ 30fps |
| **Photo Resolution** | High Resolution JPEG |
| **Battery Timing** | 90 minutes continuous video |
| **Charging** | Micro-USB – Samsung charger supported |
| **Memory** | Micro SD card up to 32GB |
| **Audio** | Built-in high sensitivity mic |
| **Usage** | Works as normal ballpoint pen + camera |

WHO IS THIS FOR?
Journalists, students, lawyers, business owners, ya koi bhi jo important conversations ka record rakhna chahta hai. Office meetings, lectures, ya personal safety ke liye perfect.

WHAT’S IN THE BOX
1x HD Camera Pen, 1x USB Cable, 1x User Manual

VIP PROMISE
100% Discreet. 100% Reliable. 100% Yours.
Cash on Delivery available. 7-day checking warranty.
